name: Kawaa API
description:
The core Kawaa REST API: verify an address or a list, follow the job, read the results, and check how a domain is set up to send mail.

This document describes the endpoints a customer integration uses. It is not the whole surface: profile and security settings (password, two-factor, sessions), billing and subscription changes and team management are reachable but not modelled here, because a specification is only worth having if every line of it is kept true, and they have no page at https://kawaa.com/docs/ yet either. Some operations that do have a page there are not modelled here either, and that page is their only reference: the white-label API (`POST /v1/white-label/sub-accounts`, `GET /v1/white-label/sub-accounts`, `GET /v1/white-label/sub-accounts/{subAccountId}`, `PUT /v1/white-label/sub-accounts/{subAccountId}`, `DELETE /v1/white-label/sub-accounts/{subAccountId}`, `POST /v1/white-label/sub-accounts/{subAccountId}/allocate`, `POST /v1/white-label/sub-accounts/{subAccountId}/reset-key`, `GET /v1/white-label/usage` and `GET /v1/white-label/usage/{subAccountId}`) at https://kawaa.com/docs/api/white-label/, the domain activity lookup (`GET /v1/activity/domain/{domain}`) at https://kawaa.com/docs/api/activity/#domain-activity, and the tracking links (`POST /v1/tracking/links` and `PUT /v1/tracking/links/{id}`), whose limits are at https://kawaa.com/docs/api/activity/#tracking-link-limits. The HubSpot, Salesforce and Mailchimp integrations are not available yet: their authorize routes answer 503 `INTEGRATION_NOT_CONFIGURED`, so no account can connect one. The guides at https://kawaa.com/docs/ cover verification, batch jobs, account and API keys, webhooks, activity, deliverability and the white-label API; the email finder (`POST /v1/find`, `POST /v1/find/bulk`), the domain lookup (`GET /v1/domain/{domain}`) and the billing catalogue (`GET /v1/billing/plans`, `GET /v1/billing/credit-packages`) are described only in this document.



**API key scopes.** A key can be limited to a list of scopes. Each operation below carries `x-kawaa-scopes` naming every scope it requires (more than one where a route genuinely touches two areas). `x-kawaa-unscoped-only: true` marks an operation a scoped key may not use at all, whatever it holds: it mints a credential, or it acts across every tenant. An operation with neither extension needs no credential. An unrestricted key (which is what every key is unless it was created with scopes) reaches everything. An OAuth access token is always scoped: an operation it can call lists the `OAuth2` scheme in its `security`, with the scopes it requires, and an authenticated operation that does not list it refuses one whatever scopes it holds.

**AI agents.** The same product is served over the Model Context Protocol at `https://api.kawaa.com/mcp`, authenticated with the same API key as an HTTP bearer token, or with an OAuth access token an agent obtains by signing in (the `OAuth2` security scheme). Twelve tools cover verification, bulk jobs (including stopping one), results and deliverability; every tool call is a call to a route described here, so the scopes, rate limits, credit accounting and idempotency below apply to it unchanged. An agent is not a separate entitlement: it is a caller. Setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity is at https://kawaa.com/docs/mcp/, and the protocol surface itself is not modelled in this document: this describes the REST API the tools call.
